firm_data.firm_description: Yankwitt LLP is a litigation firm in Westchester County that handles civil and complex criminal matters in state and federal courts throughout the region. They represent businesses and high-net-worth individuals across a broad range of disputes.
notable_facts: Named a Best Place to Work: Law Firms by The Best Companies Group for the second consecutive year in 2024.
Recognized as a top commercial litigation firm in New York by Chambers USA for the fifth consecutive year in 2025.

email.subject: AI for Yankwitt LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Russell,

Congratulations on being named a Best Place to Work by The Best Companies Group for the second consecutive year in 2024. That recognition reflects the kind of culture that attracts top talent, especially when competing across complex litigation and appellate matters.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Westchester region to meet firms handling the kind of civil and criminal disputes you specialize in. I'd be happy to stop by your White Plains office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
